main_text.l: quín, si excolantur multū, in quauis
re cōsequi possint. Attici, aliíq; Græci
per excelleti ingenio habiti sunt: un
de & ab eis omnes fermè disciplinæ,
tra Bœotij, in crassiore cœlo nati, lo
ingeniū: & ut Horat. ait, Bœotū in
crasso iurares aere natū: cū tamē ea
simū dederit. Atq; idem de reliquis
res, atq; ad omnes disciplinas aptio-
crassiore: nō ob animi uim quidē

page.notes: Printed text is clear. Some words in the line-ends are uncertain (e.g. "quauis", "excelleti", "temperationē") and are transcribed as printed. The signature mark at the foot left is partly illegible and is given approximately.
